approved.description: How many of its proposals were approved.

count.description: How many of the month's proposals were of it.

edited.description: How many of the approved ones were approved with an item changed or removed (an edit before approving).

median_decision_seconds.description: The median time from its proposals to their decisions, in seconds.

reversed.description: How many of the approved ones were undone afterwards (AI-91).

share.description: Of the month's proposals, from 0 to 1.
